category_title: Students with low online continuity and infrequent LMS participation
minimal_context: The student is instructed to post about their weekend plans on the asynchronous discussion board and reply to peers.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please go to the discussion board and post a few lines describing your favorite type of music or your plans for the weekend, and then respond to two or three of your peers’ postings.

STUDENT: I saw that assignment on the LMS, but I haven't been interacting with the online materials or the Nexos textbook very much lately.

TUTOR: You should try to log in and get the work done.

STUDENT: I'm struggling with it. I have significantly lower levels of participation compared to what is expected, and I'm missing a lot of on-time submissions.

TUTOR: Just do your best to catch up on the missing posts.

STUDENT: I honestly just lack the discipline and motivation required to succeed in online learning. I've fallen completely below the minimum 50 days of activity and 45 minutes of active participation.

options.A: Provide a communication book composed of a typed conversational opener with a corresponding Picture Communication Symbol.
options.B: Offer a range of invitations in the form of discussion prompts designed to engage students with their literate lives.
options.C: Use learning analytics within the LMS for the early identification of at-risk students in the online course.
options.D: Provide a model answer in the form of a sample student's discussion post, drawing attention to available LMS resources.
